opportunities.title: Research Fund

amount.raw: up to £5000 of funding for 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) holding an independent research post; not holding another active Research Fund grant; one application per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, up to £5000 for 12 months, covering chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and access.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund

amount.raw: Grants awarded in 2026; 80% on signing and final 20% after evaluation review

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants aged 18 and over, UK or Republic of Ireland residents (or applying on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI); project must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funds chemistry-based public engagement and outreach projects connecting communities with the chemical sciences, prioritising under-represented audiences, member engagement skills, positive social outcomes, intergenerational audiences, and adult engagement.

opportunities.title: Researcher Development and Travel Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Partner Scientist, Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) who are PhD students or researchers in the chemical sciences within 10 years of leaving full-time education.
opportunities.summary: Supports PhD students and early-career scientists with up to £500 for activities that develop their research career, such as conference participation, training courses, networking or organising scientific meetings.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) before submission and for the duration of the grant; PhD students or researchers at any career stage in any sector or location.
opportunities.summary: Enables researchers to establish and develop national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations and networks, funding research visits to collaborators' institutions and organising meetings/workshops.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Chemists based in the UK or Ireland, or based outside with valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; must incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related event and have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 per year to help carers attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event by covering additional costs of care they usually provide.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Chemists based in the UK or Ireland, or based outside with valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; must use funds for support/assistance personally required relating to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 per year to help with the cost of specific support to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event, covering accessibility needs such as travel, personal assistance, communication support and assistive technology.
